block.noOther: Pick a computer and a folder on the other side first.
block.otherComputer: The other side shows another computer. Copying between computers comes later.
block.otherStopped: The computer on the other side is not running.
block.otherUnlisted: The other side's folder isn't open yet.
block.sameFolder: The other side shows this same folder.
block.intoItself: The other side is inside this folder.
block.deep: The other side's folder is too deep to put this in.
copy.title: Copy {{name}}
move.title: Move {{name}}
copy.taken: {{name}} is already in {{folder}}. This copy gets the name {{newName}}; nothing is replaced.
move.taken: {{name}} is already in {{folder}}. It moves there as {{newName}}.
takenNoName: {{name}} is already in {{folder}}, and there is no free name to give it. Rename one of them first.
badName: This can't be put in {{folder}} under this name.
move.protected: This is part of the computer's system. Moving it can stop programs from working.
move.holdsMount: This holds the open storage {{name}}. Close it in Storage first.
move.mountsUnknown: Couldn't read which storages are open on this computer, so folders can't be moved now. Try again in a moment.
move.places: Moving between {{from}} and {{to}} can't be done in one step. Copy it; the original stays.
move.crosses: These two folders are on different disks, so this can't be moved in one step. Copy it; the original stays.
move.checkFailed: Couldn't check where this is, so it can't be moved now.
exists: Something named {{name}} is in {{folder}} now. Nothing was changed.
held.copy: Copying {{name}} to {{dest}} may have gone through.
held.move: Moving {{name}} to {{dest}} may have gone through.
held.sourceGone: {{name}} is no longer in {{folder}}, so this copy can't be checked.
held.sourceChanged: {{name}} in {{folder}} has changed kind since it was copied, so this copy can't be checked.
held.stopBody: The Hub stops checking it. It may have gone through: look in {{dest}}. Nothing is sent again.
held.unchecked: Copying {{name}} to {{dest}} was not checked. It may have gone through: look in {{dest}}.
verdict.copyNone: It wasn't copied: nothing new is in {{folder}}.
verdict.copyOther: It wasn't copied: something else named {{name}} is in {{folder}}, and it was not replaced.
verdict.moveNone: It wasn't moved: {{name}} is still in {{folder}}.
verdict.elsewhere: This was checked in another tab or window. Look in {{folder}} to see what is there.
skipped.title: {{name}} had become a folder. It was copied into {{folder}}, but {{count}} items in it were left out.
skipped.one: {{name}} had become a folder. It was copied into {{folder}}, but 1 item in it was left out.
skipped.outside: {{path}}: a link to a place the files program doesn't serve
walk.plan: {{name}} holds {{count}} items. All of them are copied, and the copy is checked against them if its answer is lost.
walk.planOne: {{name}} holds 1 item. It is copied, and the copy is checked against it if its answer is lost.
walk.planEmpty: {{name}} is empty. The empty folder is copied.
walk.links: Links in it are copied as links, not as what they point to.
walk.left: These can't be copied (pipes, sockets or devices) and are left out.
walk.failed: Couldn't read everything in {{name}}, so it can't be copied now. Try again in a moment.
walk.big: {{name}} is too big to copy from the Hub in one go: over {{entries}} items or {{folders}} folders. Copy the folders in it one at a time.
walk.deep: {{name}} holds folders too deep for the Hub to check the copy. Copy the folders in it one at a time.
walk.names: Some names in {{name}} can't be read from the Hub yet, so the copy couldn't be checked. Rename them first.
walk.unreadable: Some items in {{name}} can't be read, so the copy would stop part way.
skipped.folderTitle: {{name}} was copied into {{folder}}, but {{count}} items in it were left out.
skipped.folderOne: {{name}} was copied into {{folder}}, but 1 item in it was left out.
held.copyPart: When checked, {{count}} items were missing or different in {{dest}}. The copy may still be running: check again in a moment.
held.copyPartOne: When checked, 1 item was missing or different in {{dest}}. The copy may still be running: check again in a moment.
walk.opaque: The Hub can't read the exact targets of some links in it. They are copied, but if the copy's answer is lost it can't be checked.
walk.planUnchecked: Everything in {{name}} is copied: {{count}} in all.
several.keepBoth: Keep both: the new one gets another name
several.readFailed: Couldn't read what is in {{folder}}, so nothing is planned yet.
several.walking: Checking what is in the folders…
several.noName: Left out: {{name}} is already there, and there is no free name to give it.
several.badName: Left out: it can't be put there under this name.
several.intoItself: Left out: the other side is inside {{name}}.
several.move.holdsMount: Left out: it holds an open storage. Close it in Storage first.
several.move.mountsUnknown: Left out: couldn't read which storages are open, so folders can't be moved now.
several.move.protected: Left out: it is part of the computer's system. Move it on its own.
several.move.places: Left out: it is on another disk or storage than the other side. Copy it on its own.
several.tooMany: Up to {{max}} items go in one press. Select fewer.
several.tooManyFolders: Up to {{max}} folders are copied in one press. Select fewer folders.
several.nothing: Nothing here can go to the other side.
several.copiedLeft: Copied, but {{count}} items in it were left out.
several.willLeave: {{count}} items in it can't be copied (pipes, sockets or devices) and will be left out.
several.willLeave_one: {{count}} item in it can't be copied (pipe, socket or device) and will be left out.
several.stopping: Stopping after the item being sent.
several.sumPending: {{name}} may have gone through, so nothing after it was sent.
several.sumFailed: {{name}} wasn't done, so nothing after it was sent.
several.madeMeanwhile: Made meanwhile: what is there is kept, nothing was copied over it.
rest.title: Copy the rest of {{name}}
rest.unchecked: Files can't check the links in this copy, so it can't tell what is missing. Nothing was sent.
rest.whole: {{dest}} holds the whole copy now. Nothing is left to copy.
rest.release: Copying the rest stops holding the first copy, which may still be running. Anything it makes meanwhile is kept: a name taken by then is skipped, never written over.
rest.nothing: Nothing is missing in {{dest}}: only the different items below are left, and they are not touched.
rest.different: Different in {{dest}}. These are not touched: copying the rest never writes over an item.
rest.more: {{count}} more go with the next press of Copy the rest.
rest.more_one: {{count}} more goes with the next press of Copy the rest.
rest.releaseFailed: Couldn't stop holding the first copy. Nothing was sent.
rest.afterWhole: Checked again: {{dest}} holds the whole copy.
rest.afterPart: Checked again: {{count}} items are still missing or different in {{dest}}.
rest.afterPart_one: Checked again: {{count}} item is still missing or different in {{dest}}.
rest.afterUnchecked: Checked again: Files can't check the links in this copy, so it can't say whether it is whole.
rest.afterFailed: Couldn't check {{dest}} again, so Files can't say whether the copy is whole.
rest.noneSendable: None of the missing items can be copied from here. Each one says why.
left.title: Left out
